title: Master Munda Source Census
description: Federated discovery census. Existing canonical source records remain in the master source register; newly discovered corpus-specific records remain in their evidence-preserving source bundles; standalone bibliographic discoveries are recorded separately. This index measures the union without duplicating or renumbering permanent source IDs.

source_registers.counting_rule: Count only volume slots with a verified external locator or a registered corpus artifact that are not already represented in the canonical master source register.

source_registers.id_policy: new standalone discoveries receive immutable SRC-MMSC identifiers after duplicate checking

metrics.note: Counts are repository-derived discovery/accounting metrics, not claims that all Munda sources have already been discovered. The current union is 14 preserved canonical master-source records, one independently located Mundarica Volume II record, and one standalone WorldCat-verified Ram Dayal Munda bibliographic record. No online or catalogue availability is interpreted as reuse permission.
